desc: a risen corpse: a shambling grey-green-skinned zombie in rotted rag clothing (a torn shirt and ragged trousers), bare feet, one arm hanging limp, the head lolling forward
defect: only two real poses, one frame a byte-copy of another
extra: It is a SHAMBLE: the knees still bend and the legs still alternate and pass, but the steps are short and dragging, the shoulders slumped, the head lolling -- a corpse walk, not a march.
